acceptance_criteria: US-HOME: hero shows logo/heading/primary CTA (اطلب الآن) clickable immediately on load, not gated behind GSAP completion (animation never blocks LCP); every home section (categories, bestsellers, offers, zones, reviews, FAQ) works with no critical extra JS, animation is progressive enhancement only; prefers-reduced-motion disables curtain/particles/parallax and shows final content directly; a failed product image shows a placeholder, never a broken layout

US-MENU: sticky category tabs track scroll position (scrollspy) with no layout jump; search normalizes Arabic input (strips tashkeel, unifies alef/taa marbuta forms) and shows a 'no results' state suggesting a nearby category; quick-preview opens in place (no navigation) and allows direct add-to-cart when the product has no mandatory options; a temporarily-unavailable product shows a badge and disables add-to-cart

US-PRODUCT: displayed price recalculates instantly on every change (size/extras/quantity), fully client-side, before any network call; mandatory options (e.g. pizza size) default to a valid value so add-to-cart is never reachable in an invalid state; changing size after selecting now-incompatible extras auto-clears them and tells the user

US-CART: total = items - discount + delivery fee (± tax if enabled) with every line itemized (no unexplained final number); the free-fries gift auto-applies per src/domain/twister/gift.ts and auto-removes if the total later drops below threshold; an invalid coupon shows a specific reason (expired/not found/below minimum) without dropping other valid coupons; an empty cart shows a CTA back to the menu, not a broken page; switching delivery zone after adding items recalculates fees without losing cart contents

US-CHECKOUT: form fields (name, Egyptian-format phone, address, area) validate before the submit button activates; the generated WhatsApp message matches docs/product/whatsapp-order-message.md's template exactly (fields, order, separators) by calling src/domain/twister/whatsapp.ts's buildWhatsAppMessage/buildWhatsAppUrl, not a reimplementation; wa.me opens synchronously inside the click handler (no intervening await) to avoid popup blocking, with a visible fallback link when blocked; very long orders abbreviate/aggregate repeated extra names instead of cutting the message off arbitrarily; a closed-hours state (src/domain/twister/hours.ts isOpenNow) warns before sending but never blocks sending

US-OFFERS: countdown computes from Africa/Cairo time via src/domain/twister/cairo-time.ts, independent of visitor device timezone, and is hydration-safe (no server/client first-paint mismatch); an offer expiring while the page is open (including offerStatus's weekly-thursday handling) updates to a disabled state automatically with no page refresh

US-REVIEWS: star ratings, animated counters, and review cards render via the RatingStars/StatCounter/TestimonialCard primitives per docs/ux/component-inventory.md, consistent with docs/product/reviews-policy.md (no fabricated rating presented as a real customer review)
US-CONTACT: WhatsApp CTA, call CTA, delivery zones, hours, and a contact form are present and functional against src/mocks/twister, matching docs/ux/wireframes.md's contact screen

US-ADMIN: every admin/** page requires an active local session and redirects an unauthenticated visitor to a login screen; CRUD for all 6 resources (products/offers/zones/coupons/banners/announcements) works fully client-side through src/lib/repositories/twister.ts and reflects immediately in the same-browser customer-facing UI; an 'Export JSON' button downloads a full snapshot of edited data; clearing browser storage falls back to the original seed data without breaking the site; composed admin pages keep AdminShell's single <main> landmark
US-STATES: loading/empty/error/offline states are covered for every primary path; no persistent element (WhatsApp CTA/cart) hides page content or crosses safe-area-inset boundaries on mobile
